facts.statement: The genus name Daanosaurus means "Da'an lizard" and refers to the Da'an district in Sichuan, China.
facts.quote: Daanosaurus (meaning "Da'an lizard" after Da'an district in Zigong, Sichuan)

facts.statement: The type species Daanosaurus zhangi was described in 2005 from fossils found in the Upper Shaximiao Formation.
facts.quote: The type species from the Upper Shaximiao Formation was described in 2005 as Daanosaurus zhangi.

facts.statement: The species name zhangi honors Zhang Aiping, the former Minister of National Defense, while the genus name refers to the Da'an district where fossils were found.
facts.quote: The genus name refers to Da'an, the district of Zigong where the specimens were found, while the species name honors Zhang Aiping, the former Minister of National Defense.

facts.statement: The only known specimen, the holotype ZDM 0193, is a partial skeleton of a juvenile individual.
facts.quote: The holotype (ZDM 0193), which is the only known specimen, was a juvenile.

facts.statement: Based on the juvenile skeleton, adults of Daanosaurus are estimated to have reached 18 meters in length, 9 meters in height, and weighed 30 tonnes.
facts.quote: Daanosaurus está basado en el esqueleto de un ejemplar juvenil y se calcula que llegaba a medir 18 metros de largo en la edad adulta, 9 m de alto y un peso de 30 toneladas.

facts.statement: Daanosaurus was originally classified in the subfamily Bellusaurinae, which is part of the family Brachiosauridae.
facts.quote: When it was described, Daanosaurus was placed in the Bellusaurinae, a sub-family of Brachiosauridae

facts.statement: Recent studies have placed Daanosaurus in the clade Macronaria based on opisthocoelous posterior dorsal vertebrae, a trait also found in mamenchisaurids.
facts.quote: More recently, Daanosaurus was placed in the Macronaria due to its opisthocoelous posterior dorsal vertebrae, but this trait is also present in mamenchisaurids.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis suggests that Daanosaurus may be a mamenchisaurid, though this classification remains debated due to the juvenile nature of the fossil.
facts.quote: When characters that vary through growth were included in the dataset, both Daanosaurus and Bellusaurus were recovered as mamenchisaurids.

facts.statement: Daanosaurus is classified within the family Brachiosauridae.
Daanosaurus lived in Asia during the Late Jurassic, approximately 156 million years ago during the Oxfordian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 156 millones de años, en el Oxfordiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: The time range for Daanosaurus is estimated from the Kimmeridgian to the Tithonian stages, between 154.8 and 143.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Kimmeridgian to Tithonian (154.8 to 143.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: The Paleobi Database lists the parent group of Daanosaurus as Mamenchisauridae.
Daanosaurus is considered by many to be a eusauropod due to its similarity to Bellusaurus.
facts.quote: Es un nuevo integrante de la familia Brachiosauridae. Debido a su parecido con Bellusaurus, es considerado por muchos un Eusauropoda.
